block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 提案・要求動詞：suggest that S + (should) 原形
example_en: The doctor suggested that he take a break.
example_ja: 医師は彼に休息を取るよう提案した。（takeは原形）
question: The auditor suggested that the accounting team ______ the financial ledger once more.
rule: suggest that S + (should) 動詞原形 の構文。主語が三人称単数であっても原形 review が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 提案・要求動詞：recommend that S + (should) 原形
example_en: She recommended that he apply.
example_ja: 彼女は彼に応募するよう勧めた。（applyは原形）
question: The consultant recommended that the firm ______ its cloud storage infrastructure.
rule: recommend that 節内の述語動詞は (should) + 動詞原形 となるため upgrade が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 提案・要求動詞：request that S + (should) 原形
example_en: The client requested that we send a copy.
example_ja: 顧客は私たちが写しを送るよう求めた。（sendは原形）
question: The project leader requested that each engineer ______ a daily status report.
rule: request that S + (should) 原形。三人称単数の each engineer が主語でも原形 submit を用いる。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 提案・要求動詞：demand that S + (should) 原形
example_en: They demanded that he apologize.
example_ja: 彼らは彼が謝罪することを要求した。（apologizeは原形）
question: The labor union demanded that management ______ workplace safety standards immediately.
rule: demand that 節内では動詞の原形 improve が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 提案・要求動詞：insist that S + (should) 原形
example_en: He insisted that she be present.
example_ja: 彼は彼女が出席するべきだと主張した。（beは原形）
question: The division director insisted that all regional managers ______ the conference.
rule: insist that S + (should) 原形 の規則に従い動詞原形 attend が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 提案・要求動詞：ask / require that S + (should) 原形
example_en: The policy requires that everyone wear a badge.
example_ja: 方針により全員がバッジを着用することが義務付けられている。
question: Municipal building codes require that every commercial exit ______ clearly marked.
rule: require that 節内では助動詞 should が省略され動詞原形（be動詞は be）となるため be が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 提案・要求動詞：propose that S + (should) 原形
example_en: The board proposed that he lead the project.
example_ja: 取締役会は彼がプロジェクトを率いるよう提案した。
question: The chief architect proposed that the firm ______ solar panels across the roof.
rule: propose that S + (should) 原形。install が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 提案・要求動詞：stipulate that S + (should) 原形
example_en: The contract stipulates that payment be made.
example_ja: 契約書には支払いがなされることが明記されている。
question: The vendor contract stipulates that the shipment ______ delivered within forty-eight hours.
rule: stipulate（規定する）に続く that 節内では受動態の be動詞も原形 be (delivered) となる。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 提案・要求動詞：advise that S + (should) 原形
example_en: The counsel advised that we remain silent.
example_ja: 弁護士は私たちが沈黙を保つよう助言した。
question: Legal counsel strongly advised that the company ______ any public comments on the lawsuit.
rule: advise that 節内は動詞の原形 postpone が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 提案・要求動詞：order / command that S + (should) 原形
example_en: The judge ordered that the documents be released.
example_ja: 裁判官は書類の公開を命じた。
question: The facility director ordered that all ventilation systems ______ shut down during the chemical leak.
rule: order that 節内は受動態の原形 be (shut down) が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 提案・要求動詞：否定文における not + 動詞原形
example_en: I insist that he not go.
example_ja: 彼が行かないことを主張する。（not+原形）
question: The supervisor recommended that the intern not ______ the master database directly.
rule: that 節内の否定形は「not + 動詞原形」となるため access が正解。does not access は不可。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 事実の主張を表す insist（仮定法原形にならない例外）
example_en: He insisted that he was innocent.
example_ja: 彼は自分が潔白だと主張した。（事実の主張なので時制一致）
question: The suspect insisted that he ______ out of the country when the embezzlement occurred.
rule: insist が「〜すべきだ（要求）」ではなく「〜であった（過去の客観的事実の主張）」を表す場合は通常の時制一致となり was が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 重要・必要を表す形容詞：It is essential that S + (should) 原形
example_en: It is essential that she be informed.
example_ja: 彼女に知らせることが極めて重要だ。（beは原形）
question: It is essential that every project supervisor ______ the weekly milestone targets.
rule: It is essential that S + (should) 原形。三人称単数主語であっても動詞原形 verify が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 重要・必要を表す形容詞：It is imperative that S + (should) 原形
example_en: It is imperative that we act quickly.
example_ja: 迅速に行動することが急務である。（actは原形）
question: It is imperative that all pharmaceutical products ______ under temperature-controlled conditions.
rule: imperative（絶対必要である）に続く that 節内では原形 remain が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 重要・必要を表す形容詞：It is crucial that S + (should) 原形
example_en: It is crucial that he attend.
example_ja: 彼が出席することが決定的に重要だ。（attendは原形）
question: It is crucial that the newly acquired equipment ______ inspected prior to activation.
rule: crucial に続く that 節内では受動態の be動詞も原形 be (inspected) となる。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 重要・必要を表す形容詞：It is vital that S + (should) 原形
example_en: It is vital that supplies be replenished.
example_ja: 物資を補給することが極めて重要だ。（beは原形）
question: It is vital that every employee ______ the revised cybersecurity guidelines.
rule: vital that S + (should) 原形。動詞原形 understand が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 重要・必要を表す形容詞：It is mandatory that S + (should) 原形
example_en: It is mandatory that everyone participate.
example_ja: 全員が参加することが義務である。（participateは原形）
question: It is mandatory that every factory operator ______ protective headgear on the floor.
rule: mandatory（義務的な）に続く that 節内では原形 wear が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 重要・必要を表す形容詞：It is necessary that S + (should) 原形
example_en: It is necessary that she submit it.
example_ja: 彼女がそれを提出することが必要だ。（submitは原形）
question: It is necessary that the chief accountant ______ all discrepancy entries.
rule: necessary that 節内は原形 reconcile が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 重要・必要を表す形容詞：It is important that S + (should) 原形
example_en: It is important that he not forget.
example_ja: 彼が忘れないことが重要だ。（not+原形）
question: It is important that the client ______ promptly of any unforeseen shipment delays.
options: [ be notified / is notified / was notified / notified ]
rule: important that 節内の受動態は原形 be notified が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 重要・必要を表す形容詞：It is advisable that S + (should) 原形
example_en: It is advisable that you consult an expert.
example_ja: 専門家に相談することが望ましい。
question: It is advisable that each tourist ______ comprehensive international travel insurance.
rule: advisable that 節内は動詞原形 obtain が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 仮定法過去の基本：現在の事実と異なる仮定（were / did）
example_en: If I had time, I would join you.
example_ja: 時間があれば参加するのだが。（現在は時間がない）
question: If our team ______ more software developers, we could accelerate the release schedule.
rule: 現在の事実に反する仮定を表す仮定法過去の条件節のため、過去形 had が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 仮定法過去：be動詞は were（三人称単数でも were）
example_en: If he were here, he would agree.
example_ja: 彼がここにいれば賛成するだろうに。（be動詞はwere）
question: If the regional manager ______ present, she would explain the budget reallocation.
rule: 仮定法過去の条件節における be動詞は、格式ある文法・TOEIC規範では三人称単数でも were を用いる。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 仮定法過去の帰結節：would / could / might + 動詞原形
example_en: If I knew, I would tell you.
example_ja: 知っていれば教えるのだが。（帰結節はwould+原形）
question: If the prototype passed all stress tests, management ______ commercial distribution.
options: [ would authorize / will authorize / authorizes / authorized ]
rule: 条件節が passed（仮定法過去）であるため、帰結節には助動詞の過去形 would authorize を用いる。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: I wish + 仮定法過去（現在の願望）
example_en: I wish I were in Hawaii.
example_ja: ハワイにいればいいのに。（現在の願望）
question: The executives wish the corporate tax rate ______ lower in this jurisdiction.
options: [ were / is / will be / have been ]
rule: I wish + 仮定法過去（were）で「（現在）〜であればいいのに」を表す。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: as if / as though + 仮定法過去（現在の様子）
example_en: He talks as if he knew everything.
example_ja: 彼は何でも知っているかのように話す。（as if+仮定法過去）
question: The young associate speaks as if she ______ the primary architect of the project.
options: [ were / is / has been / will be ]
rule: as if + 仮定法過去（were）で「まるで〜であるかのように」を表す。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: It is time + 仮定法過去（もう〜してもよい時間だ）
example_en: It is time we left.
example_ja: もう出発してもよい時間だ。（過去形を用いる）
question: It is high time the municipal committee ______ the deteriorating harbor bridge.
rule: It is high time S + 過去形 で「とっくに〜すべき時間だ」を表す慣用構文。repaired が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: without / but for + 仮定法過去（もし〜がなければ）
example_en: Without water, we could not live.
example_ja: 水がなければ生きていけない。（現在の仮定）
question: Without persistent corporate sponsorship, the arts festival ______ unable to continue.
options: [ would be / will be / is / has been ]
rule: Without ~（もし〜がなければ）を受けた現在の仮定法帰結節であるため would be が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: If it were not for ~（もし今〜がなければ）
example_en: If it were not for your help, I would fail.
example_ja: あなたの助けがなければ失敗するだろう。
question: If it ______ not for the dedicated volunteer staff, the charity summit would collapse.
rule: 「If it were not for ~（もし今〜がなければ）」の定型仮定法構文。were が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 仮定法過去完了の基本：過去の事実に反する仮定（had p.p.）
example_en: If I had known, I would have helped.
example_ja: 知っていたら助けたのに。（過去の事実に反する）
question: If the laboratory ______ the critical error earlier, the recall would have been avoided.
options: [ had detected / detected / detects / has detected ]
rule: 帰結節が would have been avoided（仮定法過去完了）であるため、条件節には had detected が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 仮定法過去完了の帰結節：would have + 過去分詞
example_en: If you had called, I would have come.
example_ja: 電話してくれたら行ったのに。
question: If the shipment had arrived on Friday, we ______ the retail orders over the weekend.
options: [ would have fulfilled / will fulfill / fulfilled / fulfill ]
rule: 条件節が had arrived（仮定法過去完了）であるため、帰結節は would have fulfilled が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: I wish + 仮定法過去完了（過去の願望・後悔）
example_en: I wish I had accepted the offer.
example_ja: その申し出を受けていればよかった。（過去の後悔）
question: The director wishes she ______ the advice of the risk assessment team last year.
options: [ had followed / followed / follows / would follow ]
rule: last year という過去の出来事に対する後悔を表すため、I wish + 仮定法過去完了 had followed が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: as if + 仮定法過去完了（過去の事実に反する様子）
example_en: He looked as if he had seen a ghost.
example_ja: 彼はまるで幽霊でも見たような顔だった。
question: The spokesperson acted as if the financial scandal ______ entirely resolved months ago.
options: [ had been / was / has been / were ]
rule: 過去の時点よりも前の事柄について「あたかも〜であったかのように」と述べるため had been が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: If it had not been for ~（もしあの時〜がなかったならば）
example_en: If it had not been for the loan, we would have gone bankrupt.
example_ja: 融資がなかったら倒産していただろう。
question: If it ______ not been for the timely intervention of the fire crew, the plant would have burned.
rule: 「If it had not been for ~（もしあの時〜がなかったならば）」の定型構文。had が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: but for / without + 仮定法過去完了（過去の事実に反する）
example_en: But for his advice, I would have failed.
example_ja: 彼の助言がなかったら失敗していただろう。
question: Without the emergency government bailout, the airline ______ forced into liquidation.
options: [ would have been / would be / was / had been ]
rule: 過去の事実（リーマンショック等での破綻危機）に対する仮定の帰結節であるため would have been が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: otherwise + 仮定法過去完了（さもなければ〜だっただろう）
example_en: We hurried; otherwise we would have missed it.
example_ja: 急いだ。さもなければ乗り遅れていただろう。
question: The technician noticed the gas leak; otherwise, a devastating explosion ______.
options: [ would have occurred / will occur / occurred / occurs ]
rule: 「otherwise（さもなければ）」に導かれる過去の仮定の帰結節であるため would have occurred が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: could have + 過去分詞（〜できたかもしれないのに・し損ねた）
example_en: You could have asked me.
example_ja: 私に尋ねることもできただろうに（実際は尋ねなかった）。
question: With a more flexible payment plan, the dealership ______ many more luxury sedans.
options: [ could have sold / can sell / will sell / sold ]
rule: 「過去に〜できただろうに（実際はしなかった）」という過去の可能性を表す could have sold が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 混合仮定法：過去の条件（had p.p.）＋現在の帰結（would do now）
example_en: If I had studied, I would be happy now.
example_ja: あの時勉強していたら、今頃幸せなのだが。（混合仮定法）
question: If the software engineers had fixed the glitch yesterday, the platform ______ fully operational now.
options: [ would be / would have been / will be / is ]
rule: 条件節は yesterday の過去の事実（had fixed）だが、帰結節は now の現在の状態を表すため would be が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 混合仮定法：過去の決断が現在の結果に影響するパターン
example_en: If we had bought it then, we would own it today.
example_ja: あの時買っていれば、今日それを所有しているのだが。
question: If the investor had purchased the prime real estate ten years ago, he ______ extremely wealthy today.
options: [ would be / would have been / will be / was ]
rule: today（今日）という現在の状態を表す語があるため、助動詞過去形 + 原形 would be が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 混合仮定法：現在の条件＋過去の帰結
example_en: If he were smarter, he would not have said that.
example_ja: 彼がもっと賢ければ、あんなことは言わなかっただろう。
question: If Ms. Dupont ______ more proficient in German, she would have accepted the Munich posting last year.
rule: 現在の一般的な語学能力（If she were proficient）が過去の受託判断（last year）に影響した文脈のため were が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 混合仮定法：now を伴う帰結節の助動詞識別
example_en: If you had taken the medicine, you would feel better now.
example_ja: 薬を飲んでいたなら、今頃気分が良いだろうに。
question: If the manufacturing plant had adopted automation last quarter, operating costs ______ lower right now.
options: [ would be / would have been / will be / are ]
rule: right now（今現在）のコスト状態を指すため、混合仮定法の帰結節として would be が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 仮定法倒置：Should S do（万一〜ならば：if の省略）
example_en: Should you have questions, please call us.
example_ja: 万一ご質問がございましたらお電話ください。（If you should haveの倒置）
question: ______ you require any additional financial documentation, please notify our office.
rule: 「If you should require ~」から if が省略され、助動詞 Should が文頭に倒置された形。Should が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 仮定法倒置：Should S be（万一〜であれば）
example_en: Should there be any delay, we will email you.
example_ja: 万一遅延がございましたらメールいたします。
question: ______ there be any discrepancies in the billing invoice, contact customer care immediately.
rule: there be の原形を導き「万一〜があれば」を表す倒置構文。Should が文頭に来る。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 仮定法倒置：Were S to do（仮に〜するならば）
example_en: Were the deal to fail, we would lose money.
example_ja: 仮に取引が破談となれば損をするだろう。（If the deal were to failの倒置）
question: ______ the negotiations to stall, both firms would suffer severe brand impairment.
rule: 「If the negotiations were to stall」から if が脱落し Were が文頭に倒置された構文。Were が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 仮定法倒置：Were S + 形容詞/名詞（if S were の倒置）
example_en: Were I in your position, I would agree.
example_ja: 私があなたの立場なら賛成するだろう。（If I wereの倒置）
question: ______ the director available today, she would personally address the shareholders.
rule: 「If the director were available」の if が省略され Were the director available と倒置された形。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 仮定法倒置：Had S p.p.（もし〜していたら：過去完了の倒置）
example_en: Had I known the truth, I would have spoken.
example_ja: 真実を知っていたら発言したのだが。（If I had knownの倒置）
question: ______ the marketing team launched the campaign earlier, sales would have exceeded projections.
rule: 「If the marketing team had launched ~」の if 省略倒置。Had が文頭に出て Had S p.p. を形成する。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 仮定法倒置：Had S not p.p.（否定文の倒置）
example_en: Had it not rained, we would have gone.
example_ja: 雨が降らなかったら行ったのに。（If it had not rainedの倒置）
question: ______ the logistics provider not expedited the freight, the assembly plant would have halted.
rule: 「If the logistics provider had not expedited...」の if 省略倒置。Had が文頭に来て Had S not p.p. となる。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 仮定法倒置：Had it not been for ~ の倒置
example_en: Had it not been for him, we would have lost.
example_ja: 彼がいなかったら負けていただろう。（If it had not been forの倒置）
question: ______ it not been for the external venture funding, our company would have succumbed to bankruptcy.
rule: 「If it had not been for ~」の if 省略倒置形「Had it not been for ~」。Had が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 仮定法倒置：Were it not for ~ の倒置
example_en: Were it not for water, we could not live.
example_ja: 水がなければ生きていけないだろう。（If it were not forの倒置）
question: ______ it not for comprehensive digital security, our servers would be vulnerable to attacks.
rule: 「If it were not for ~」の if 省略倒置形「Were it not for ~」。Were が正解。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 仮定法倒置：Should S fail to do（万一〜し損ねたら）
example_en: Should you fail to register, you cannot enter.
example_ja: 万一登録を怠った場合は入場できません。
question: ______ the applicant fail to submit a certified transcript, the application will be voided.
rule: 三人称単数の applicant に対して動詞原形 fail が続いているため、助動詞 Should の倒置構文である。

block: Block 2-4 助動詞・仮定法・提案要求動詞
topic: 仮定法倒置：Had S + 過去分詞の帰結節との呼応
example_en: Had we secured the contract, our revenues would have soared.
example_ja: 契約を獲得していたら売上は急上昇しただろう。（Had S p.p.）
question: ______ the overseas subsidiary secured the distribution license, profits would have surged significantly.
rule: 帰結節が would have surged（仮定法過去完了）であるため、条件節の if 省略倒置「Had + 主語 + 過去分詞（secured）」が正解。
